meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 Exa 搜索引擎帮你查网络资料，也能从你给的网址抓取内容。遇到科学或技术类问题，它会优先筛选学术论文和学术网站，还能一次提取多个网页、文章或 PDF。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索、查找信息，或提取指定网址的内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索量子计算领域的最新论文
say.note: 会触发网络搜索并偏向学术来源
会抓取该网址的正文内容

say.text: 搜索一下关于太阳能电池的研究资料
say.note: 普通网络搜索，按主题返回结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can search the web via Exa and extract content from URLs you provide. For scientific or technical queries, it biases toward scholarly sources and can batch-extract webpages, articles, or academic PDFs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search, look something up, or extract content from a specific URL.

say_en.text: Search for the latest papers on quantum computing.
say_en.note: Triggers web search with academic bias.

say_en.text: Find research materials on solar cells.
